correctness.rationale: Verified affine invariant conditioning: independent uniform signed plane offset s and axial normal u. For section center c=su and axial semiamplitude A=√((1−s²)(1−u²)), two components iff c−A<−a and c+A>b; zero iff entire circle lies outside. After u,s sine coordinates, cosU cosV density and explicit triangular-strip integral give p0,p1,p2. Strict monotonicity of arccos and sqrt, H(t)=arccos(t)√(1−t²) strict concavity, and derivative comparison establish unique centered extremum and displaced minimum. Expansion at h↑1/2 gives coefficient (π+2)/4. Independently classified raw planes using five 400×400 midpoint grids (within 0.006 absolute probability) and seven strict fixed-area comparisons; these approximate checks corroborate only.
